method: Visual reading of vendored card fronts. Bracket tokens denote pictograms; rooms arrays preserve printed numbers, not inferred room count. Empty arrays indicate visibly absent special-rules panel. Flavor text is retained separately from rules.
cards: The estate has remained secret for far too long... Thus, it was the rightful owner's decision to send you on a mission to scout ahead. Who knew what horrors lurked in the shadows though?
The Monsters' unholy presence tainted the very opulent halls of this estate, casting dark shadows over its ruins. Thus, your orders were quite clear: "Slay them all!"

Wealth brings wealth, and to this estate's noble destitute family this was only but a saying. However, the owner was adamant that various riches could be found in the ruins: "Venture through the ruins and take back what was ours! Bring wealth and glory back to our noble family!"
One Lair Room must be cleared as the minimum Quest goal. Clearing Lairs awards 10[gold].
After the Quest is over, you can give any amount of Gold to the Heir, gaining 1 Xp/20[gold] given.

A revered ancestor was laid to rest in the ruins, their sacred bones left untouched. But what is dead should remain as such. Thus, the noble duty fell upon your shoulders - to retrieve them, lest they fall prey to the dark taint of the land.

Objective Rooms are [ruins]7. A Hero must spend 2 actions in the [green-area] Area to recover the bones. Set aside the room [ruins]7 at the start of the quest; you will not use it in other meetings. Objective Rooms are cleared only if the bones have been collected.
Time passes and the demons grow stronger, casting a heavier shadow upon your very existence. That's why you were tasked to enter the ruins and cull their numbers, putting them to the sword...
Curio Rooms always have Battles. When spawning Monsters in Curio Rooms, draw 1 Level 2 Monster.

As the cult's ominous rituals taint the halls of the ruins, dark gods begin to converge over the estate. This cannot be left unanswered. Delve deep into their lair and put an end to the cultists' rituals once and for all!
Objective Rooms are Rooms [ruins]4 & [ruins]8. Pick one at random each time you enter. Set them aside when you start the Quest; you won't use them during other encounters.
The path ahead in the ruins is littered by fearsome terrors and the nightmarish cult. Put an end to them, clear the path once and for all!

Their numbers have increased as they infest more Rooms, turning them into lairs. This must be stopped lest the entire ruins get overrun by these Monsters. Enter the ruins and ransack their hideouts, make them pay for what they've caused.
Thin their numbers. Nothing can be achieved if their leaders remain intact. Thus, you're tasked to find them and eradicate them once and for all.
In Objective Rooms, spawn 1 Bone Bearer (Level III)
Those once majestic works are turned to odious cesspools. Save them, purify them, deliver them from evil!

Objective Rooms are [ruins]3. Add 3 [potion] to your starting Provisions if possible. When in an Objective Room, the Healing Fountain does not function unless a Hero spends 2 actions and 1 [potion] when there to purify it. Objective Rooms are cleared only if the Healing Fountain has been purified. Set aside the room [ruins]3 at the start of the quest; you will not use it in other meetings.

The dark recesses of the ruins house even more sinister and potent shadows. We must light up the hall's torches, bringing light and warmth, courage and hope. Thus you are tasked, with torches in hand and a righteous purpose.
After rolling for Provisions, each Hero may turn one of them into a [torch]. Use a [torch] in Dark Rooms to light them up (in addition to its standard effect) and clear them.
Your biggest expedition to the Darkest Dungeon will only succeed if you set up some forward camps. Venture deep into the ruins and set up those camps, lest you fall prey to tiredness and darkness.
Use a [torch] or a [tool] in Empty Rooms to set up forwards camps. To set up this Dungeon, use 3 Empty Rooms and randomize non-Objective rooms for the rest.

Treachery will never rest, even unto death. For recent reports have shown that a group of undead soldiers roam the ruins' halls. They bear the arms and insignia of an old band of turncoats. 'Tis only a matter of vengeance, as the owner has asked you to find them and eradicate them, once and for all!
In Objective Room spawn a Bone Captain who has +20 Life and +2 Dodge

An abyssal influence is spreading among the ruins, beckoning more followers into undeath and eternal servitude. Nothing can be done unless their numbers are reduced, for the undead never tire and will never cease to threaten your very existence.
Whenever an Unholy Monster is spawned, Heroes suffer [stress]+1 each.
The gates of oblivion have opened, spouting forth horrible nightmares that call the ruins their lair. Enter those dens, obliterate their denizens and deliver these halls from evil!
Do not spawn any Level 1 Monsters in Lairs
The Threat has shown itself. Now is the time to strike! Find its lair and eradicate it.
Set up this Dungeon according to the Boss Quest rules. You can't return to the Hamlet before you defeat the Boss!

Now that the waters of the cove have receded, it's high time you ventured there and collected a good deal of samples. Not barnacles and dead fish mind you, but the clues that will shed some light onto what lives down there, and what threats you are about to face in the imminent future...

Set aside Room Cards [cove]2, [cove]5, and [cove]8, when entering an Objective Room, draw one of those cards at random. When a Hero is in an Area [A] of an Objective Room, they can spend 2 actions to gather a sample. Keep track of the samples by placing Wounds on the Quest Card. The Quest Card can not have more than 6 [wound].

It's time you mapped out more of the underground network deep in the coves. Swim to the submerged grotto and there you'll find an entrance to the vast caverns. Explore as much as you can and map out the area carefully. No one knows what lurks down there.
Always initiate battle in Curio Rooms.
